passages.quote: Approached by the majority, I reluctantly agreed to the decision of removing her from the Fresh Family. Caught in the whirlwind of peer pressure, I, too, surrendered to the majority vote. So, there I was, unknowingly caught in the web of envy and peer pressure. I never realised that in trying to preserve the atmosphere of harmony, I was unintentionally contributing to the destruction of our once-tight group. Lillian, my unsuspecting cornerstone, was ousted from the Fresh Family. In the aftermath, I found myself in a whirlwind of regret. passages.quote: Ah, picture this: it's my birthday, and I'm thinking, "Hey, no water pour today, right?" Wrong! You see, in our tradition, birthdays come with a splash – literally. Throughout the day, they didn't pour any droplet of water on me. Perharps, just perhaps, they had forgotten about the infamous water escapade. As the day wore on and the sun began to set, I felt pretty confident that I had dodged the water bullet. As the night crept in, I was like, "Phew, made it throughout the day without a splash!"
